fishing: WHEN: Mon Nov 2, winds easing after prior ENE 10-35 mph blow that pushed water out; sheltered Lemon Bay / passes best, deeper pockets. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, flounder, pompano, sheepshead near Stump Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota on live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, sheepshead, mangrove snapper on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats, Chadwick pier. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper / cobia / sheepshead on wrecks when calm enough. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards (1-3"), soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Greg Stamper Oct 30-Nov 1: windy low water concentrating redfish/snappers/trout/black drum/sheepshead), Fishin Franks 10/30 (Lemon Bay pier sheepshead/snapper/ladyfish; redfish/snook/trout in bays).
redtide: FWC Oct 30: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay and Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Charlotte and Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key / Englewood Beach / Palm Island / Boca Grande GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2-59, Sarasota ~148-149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
